+
+

+    model: str = OPENAI_TTS_MODEL
+    timeout: float = 120.0
+
+
+def load_speech_config(api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> SpeechConfig:

+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")

+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def create_session(api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> requests.Session:
+    session = requests.Session()
+    session.headers.update(build_auth_headers(api_key=api_key))
+    return session
+
+
+def speech_api_url(path: str, base_url: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    root = (base_url or OPENAI_API_BASE).rstrip("/")

+    return f"{root}{suffix}"
+
+

+

+        return payload["data"]
+    if isinstance(payload, list):
+        return payload
+    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected voice list response format")

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: synthesize_text.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TTS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech"
+OPENAI_TTS_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini-tts"
+
+
+def synthesize_text(text: str, voice: str = "alloy", format: str = "mp3", speed: float = 1.0, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> bytes:
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
+    if not voice:
+        raise ValueError("voice must not be empty")
+    if not format:
+        raise ValueError("format must not be empty")
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_TTS_MODEL,
+        "input": text,
+        "voice": voice,
+        "format": format,
+        "speed": speed,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_TTS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.content
+
+
+def synthesize_text_base64(text: str, voice: str = "alloy", format: str = "mp3", speed: float = 1.0, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(synthesize_text(text, voice=voice, format=format, speed=speed, api_key=api_key)).decode("ascii")
*** End Patch
